messages.subject: Re: Insufficient values in manual scale. 22 needed but only 16 provided
parts:
Have a look at the Hues package for a very easy one liner to generate
random color palettes of various lengths:
https://github.com/johnbaums/hues

The main function is iwanthue(). It can generate vectors with n
colors, where n is the length of e.g. the unique levels of a factor:
length(unique(Afribiota_Class$Class)) or length(levels(Afribiota_Class$Class))

Be aware that i) these are random colors (so you might want to fix the
RNG seed) and ii) that once you want to draw several barcharts with
consistent fills/colors for several sample groups with various, but
overlapping
factor levels, you might want to fix the colors anyway.

HTH, Tim

Zitat von Yogesh Gupta <nabiy...@gmail.com>:

> Hi,
>
> How I can add more color, is there any way to set the automatic required
> number of color?
> Error:Error: Insufficient values in manual scale. 22 needed but only 16
> provided.
>
> *Code:*
>
> #### Graphic representation of all samples according to metadata set the
> color palettes and make the plots####
> class_colors <- c(
> "#CBD588", "yellow", "#5F7FC7", "orange", "#508578", "#CD9BCD",
> "#AD6F3B", "#673770","black", "#652926", "#C84248",
> "#8569D5","blue", "#5E738F","#D1A33D", "#8A7C64", "#599861", "grey",
> "#D14285", "#DA5724"
> )
> phylum_colors <- c(
> "#599861", "orange","#DA5724", "#508578", "#CD9BCD",
> "#AD6F3B", "#CBD588", "#673770","#5F7FC7", "#D14285", "#652926", "#C84248",
> "#8569D5", "#5E738F","#D1A33D", "#8A7C64"
> )
> # Plot according to Sample Type and Country
> pdf("Class composition of Soil.Samples.pdf", #name of file to print. can
> also include relative or absolute path before filename.
> width = 30, # define plot width and height. completely up to user.
> height = 10)
> ggplot(Afribiota_Class, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Class)) +
> facet_wrap(.~Season, scales = "free_x") +
> theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size=18), axis.text.x =
> element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size=5), axis.title.y =
> element_text(size=18), title =element_text(size=26, face='bold')) +
> geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
> scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
> scale_x_discrete(
> drop = FALSE
> ) +
> # Remove x axis title
> theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
> theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="white"), panel.grid.major =
> element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.spacing =
> unit(0.2, "lines")) +
> guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, keywidth = 1, keyheight = 1)) +
> ylab("Relative Abundance") +
> ggtitle("Class Composition of Soil samples")
> dev.off()
>
> *Many thanks,*
> *nabiyogesh*
